# runpod_network_volumes (Data Source)

All network volumes owned by the authenticated account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_network_volumes" "all" {}

output "volume_sizes" {
  description = "Allocated size in GB per volume, keyed by volume id."
  value       = { for v in data.runpod_network_volumes.all.network_volumes : v.id => v.size }
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `network_volumes` (Attributes List) One entry per network volume. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--network_volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_volumes`

Read-Only:

- `data_center` (String) Data center holding the volume.
- `id` (String) Volume identifier.
- `name` (String) Human-readable volume name.
- `size` (Number) Allocated storage in GB.
- `type` (String) Storage tier: STANDARD or HIGH_PERFORMANCE.
